fields.summary_ko.0: Walmart (NASDAQ: WMT) Q3 revenue $188.8B (+5.2%), adjusted EPS 65 cents exceeded consensus but U.S. comparable sales 2.9% (expected 3.1%) missed, declining about 2% in pre-market.
